name: Work Review
tagline: Executive navy-and-gold review deck for project progress or work performance: results against goals, row-aligned workstreams, initiatives, reflections and next steps, with detail one click away.
density: medium on the slide (headline, labelled fields, numbers); detail in popups

palette.description: all-dark navy with a faint 80px grid, warm off-white text and one antique-gold accent; light diagrams sit on white plates; solid gold marks the single top priority

typography.cn: Noto Serif SC / Noto Sans SC
typography.style: 48px serif slide titles with a gold underline and gold-italic second half, 30px panel titles, mono uppercase kickers; nothing below 18px at 1600x900

canvas: fluid 100vw x 100vh slides, sizes in calc(N * var(--u)), --u = min(1vw, 1.7778vh); checked at 1600x900 and 1280x720
best_for: Any review that reports results against goals and backs them with workstreams, initiatives and a plan: project progress, quarterly business or team reviews, individual performance reviews.
avoid_for: Media-heavy product pitches (use byteplus) and warm teaching decks (use bible-study).
layouts: key highlights: shared context + two workstreams
progress by workstream, row per field
key initiatives hub opening full-slide popups
reflections: what went well / what to improve
next steps: plan diagram + numbered priorities
navigation: arrows, space, Home/End, wheel, swipe, nav dots; popups are outside the arrow-key sequence; Esc closes the top layer
branding: none: an [Organisation] text slot sits where a logo would go
source: generic review deck; no personal, company or customer information
